summary: Iter-13 — Listing-level pre-stage data room (option D: a+c) and Vault auto-clone on open. Wrote 9 backend pytest cases (TestListingStagedFiles + TestVaultAutoClone) covering CRUD, AES-256-GCM at rest (response shape + decrypt round-trip), 400/413/403 edge cases, 7-folder coercion, and the end-to-end clone flow: stage 2 files → buyer inquire → seller engage → open-room → vault detail.files contains both clones with cloned_from_listing_file pointing back to originals + encrypted:true + encryption_alg:AES-256-GCM → buyer signs NDA via /accept-nda → buyer downloads cloned files and gets the EXACT original plaintext (SHA-256 match) → /audit/logs contains listing.stagedfile.upload and dealroom.open with meta.cloned_staged_files>=2. All 9/9 pass. Frontend playwright: /app/listings shows per-listing ListingDataRoom collapsibles; folder dropdown has exactly 7 options; upload button disabled-until-file-picked; uploaded row shows AES-256 pill + folder + size + page count + timestamp; in DealRoomDetail the new header 'Upload document' button (data-testid=header-upload-btn) is present, switches to the Files tab on click and focuses upload-file-input. Visual confirmation of the clone flow on Helios MedTech vault — already shows the cloned TEST_clone_fin.txt / TEST_clone_legal.txt rows the backend test seeded.
action_items: Helios MedTech vault now contains several TEST_clone_* files from the auto-clone integration test (also visible on the listing data room from the earlier round-trip test on Vertex Climate — those were cleaned up). Consider a one-shot cleanup of `TEST_clone_fin.txt` / `TEST_clone_legal.txt` rows from /app/rooms/23f17e14-... if a clean demo is needed; the listing-level staged copies were already soft-deleted by the test.

Optional: dedupe auto-clone — if open-room is called twice (e.g. seller re-opens a closed-and-reopened inquiry path), staged files would be cloned again. Current implementation early-returns the existing room when one already exists, so this is safe today, but worth a comment noting the idempotency relies on the inquiry→room 1:1 mapping.

Optional consistency: the listing-staged response uses keys `target`/`meta` while the audit log returns those same keys; some test code in this repo expected `target_id`/`metadata`. Confirm public API contract documentation lists `target` + `meta` so future consumers don't drift.
critical_code_review_comments: Encryption-at-rest is correctly implemented with per-file AAD on the listing side (`listing:{lid}:{file_id}`) AND re-encrypted with a vault-bound AAD (`{room_id}:{new_file_id}`) on clone, which is exactly what the spec asked for. Verified end-to-end by round-tripping the plaintext through both layers and asserting SHA-256 equality.
_clone_listing_files_into_room correctly per-file try/except's so one bad blob does not abort the room opening, and open_deal_room wraps the whole clone in a try/except too — defensive depth is good.
Folder whitelist coercion to 'other' is implemented in the right place (server-side) — frontend dropdown happens to match, so any client-side bypass still ends up sanitized.
Response from POST /listings/{lid}/staged-files/binary correctly pops `_id`, `content`, and `pages` — verified explicitly in the test.
Audit log key is `meta` (not `metadata`) — test was adjusted to read both for forward-compat; consider documenting this in the public API spec.
ListingDataRoom subcomponent is ~180 LOC inside MyListings.jsx — fine for now but if more form fields are added consider extracting to its own file under /pages/listings/.

Notarization runs as asyncio.create_task() — fire-and-forget is OK here since Bitcoin anchoring is best-effort, but errors are not surfaced to the operator anywhere. Consider a 'last_notarize_status' on the listing_staged_files doc for diagnostics.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all six checked behaviors verified: dataroom toggles, 7-option folder dropdown, disabled-until-file submit, AES-256 pill on row, header-upload-btn visibility + tab switch + focus, cloned files visible in vault
